opening.argument: The video provides practical instruction on established ways for streamers to generate revenue, including affiliate links, additional content channels, and viewer donations. It explains that Amazon affiliate links are tied to the creator’s account and recommends making a YouTube channel, while also giving operational guidance on placing donation links in panels and chat. The promotional material is accompanied by a clear disclosure that product-link clicks may earn the speaker a small commission. Nothing presented requires viewers to transfer money or provide data, and the discount promotion is ordinary rather than a deceptive financial claim. Although the Patreon discussion mentions potentially restricted content, the available evidence does not establish that viewers are directed to evade any rule.

citations.quote: In this video right here I'm going to show you all the ways to make more money on Twitch.
By becoming an Amazon affiliate, it gives you the ability to take SKUs that are on Amazon's marketplace and generate them into clickable URLs that are tied to your account.
What you want to do is actually have links in your panels and in your chat bot so that way people know how to donate and where to donate
This video and description contain sponsored material & affiliate links, which means that if you click on one of the product links, I’ll receive a small commission.
